three_state_logic.PASS: Evidence supports the candidate on this dimension.
three_state_logic.KILL: Specific evidence demonstrates that the candidate fails this dimension. KILL requires: kill_claim, specific_observation, source_id, source_hash, evidence_span, reasoning_link.
three_state_logic.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: Available evidence is insufficient to determine PASS or KILL. NOT KILL. NOT PASS.
three_state_logic.critical_rule: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE is NOT KILL. INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE is NOT PASS.

not_proven_vs_false.rule_1: Absence of evidence is not evidence of failure.
not_proven_vs_false.rule_2: Do not infer KILL solely because the candidate lacks proof.
not_proven_vs_false.rule_3: Do not infer PASS solely because no contradiction was found.
not_proven_vs_false.rule_4: Use INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE when the available evidence cannot establish either PASS or KILL.

neutral_framing.v2: Evaluate the candidate against the evidence / neutral evidence evaluator

neutral_dimensions.name: MECHANISM
neutral_dimensions.v1: Is the mechanism unsupported by evidence?
neutral_dimensions.v2: Does the available evidence support the proposed mechanism?

neutral_dimensions.name: TRANSFER
neutral_dimensions.v1: Is the transfer from source to device weak or superficial?
neutral_dimensions.v2: Does the available evidence support the transfer from source to device?

neutral_dimensions.name: BOUNDARY_CONDITION
neutral_dimensions.v1: Are boundary conditions missing or violated?
neutral_dimensions.v2: Does external evidence establish a boundary condition that would invalidate the candidate?

neutral_dimensions.name: PRIOR_ART
neutral_dimensions.v1: Does this appear to be already known?
neutral_dimensions.v2: Does the available external evidence establish that the candidate is already specifically disclosed?

neutral_dimensions.name: COMBINATION
neutral_dimensions.v1: Is this an obvious combination of known techniques?
neutral_dimensions.v2: Does the available external evidence establish that the combination is already taught or would be routine?

neutral_dimensions.name: ENGINEERING_FEASIBILITY
neutral_dimensions.v2: Does the available evidence demonstrate an engineering constraint that makes this infeasible?

neutral_dimensions.name: REGULATORY_FEASIBILITY
neutral_dimensions.v2: Does the available evidence establish a regulatory barrier that cannot be overcome?

neutral_dimensions.name: FALSIFIABILITY
neutral_dimensions.v2: Does the candidate provide a falsification test that could prove it wrong?

evidence_requirement_for_kill.if_absent: KILL is INVALID. Convert to INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.

prior_art_firewall: REMAINS: TOPICAL_RELATED, POSSIBLE_RELEVANCE, NO_MATCH_FOUND, UNRESOLVED cannot yield PRIOR_ART=KILL. Only SPECIFIC_DISCLOSURE, IDENTICAL_OR_NEAR_IDENTICAL_DISCLOSURE may support KILL.
boundary_firewall: REMAINS: Boundary KILL requires semantic external evidence resolver.

overall_verdict_logic.OVERALL_KILL: At least one dimension has a VALID KILL
overall_verdict_logic.OVERALL_INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: No valid KILL exists AND at least one dimension is INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE

aic_gate_adapter.rule: Do not treat INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE as a pass

invariants: Contract frozen BEFORE any V5 API calls
Three-state logic: PASS / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE / KILL at both dimension and overall level
No large-model escape hatch — test same models with corrected contract
Coverage must be reported — cannot pass by abstaining on everything
